import zlib
import requests

base = "http://localhost:8081/.git/objects"

trees = {
    "final_tree": "7d7e4aadd0fbe0b14a08ceb4031f45e7d05bae82",
    "what_is_this_tree": "b225291ed2653503ce9f9710e97004533fe14cdf",
    "initial_tree": "d882f2708ad858bad5c2fbc7750c9c588e98e6eb"
}

def parse_tree(raw):
    # Skip "tree <size>\0" header
    null_idx = raw.index(b'\0')
    data = raw[null_idx+1:]
    entries = []
    pos = 0
    while pos < len(data):
        # Find space (end of mode)
        space_idx = data.index(b' ', pos)
        mode = data[pos:space_idx].decode()
        # Find null (end of name)
        null_idx2 = data.index(b'\0', space_idx)
        name = data[space_idx+1:null_idx2].decode()
        # 20-byte SHA1
        sha1 = data[null_idx2+1:null_idx2+21].hex()
        entries.append((mode, name, sha1))
        pos = null_idx2 + 21
    return entries

for name, sha in trees.items():
    url = f"{base}/{sha[:2]}/{sha[2:]}"
    r = requests.get(url)
    try:
        data = zlib.decompress(r.content)
        print(f"\n=== {name} ({sha[:7]}) ===")
        entries = parse_tree(data)
        for mode, fname, fsha in entries:
            print(f"  {mode} {fname} -> {fsha}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
EOF
